name: Naturepedia x402 Retrieval Pricing Map
author: Robbie George
system: Naturepedia / Robbie’s Razor / Grand Compression / RKCA

pricingTiers.name: Free Discovery and Previews
pricingTiers.useCase: Metadata, endpoint descriptions, previews, health, licensing signals, and validation information.

pricingTiers.name: Atomic Canonical Query
pricingTiers.useCase: One fact, identifier resolution, routing result, or compact canonical answer.

pricingTiers.name: Enriched Relationship Query
pricingTiers.useCase: Multiple relationships, citations, provenance, or modest enrichment.

pricingTiers.name: Structured Plate
pricingTiers.useCase: One complete structured Plate payload with registered relationships, citations, provenance, and governance fields.

pricingTiers.name: Bounded Subtree, Registry, or System Map
pricingTiers.useCase: One bounded multi-record registry, taxonomy subtree, identity graph, or System Map retrieval.

pricingTiers.name: Full Registry or Knowledge Mesh Snapshot
pricingTiers.useCase: One complete registry snapshot, expanded registry, Knowledge Mesh, RRIP payload, or protected state resource.

rightsBoundary.x402Conveys: One endpoint-level retrieval of the identified resource.

interpretation: This repository file is a non-enforcing reference mirror. The live production pricing manifest and actual production 402 response remain authoritative.
attribution: Created by Robbie George, Architect of Record for Naturepedia, Robbie’s Razor, and the Grand Compression knowledge system.
